name: Can chair rails be installed on textured walls?

mainEntity.name: Can chair rails be installed on textured walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, chair rails can be installed on textured walls, but the process requires careful attention to ensure a secure and flush fit. For heavily textured surfaces, some preparation work might be necessary, such as sanding down the installation line slightly to create a smoother surface for adhesion. Alternatively, caulk can be used to fill any small gaps between the chair rail and the textured wall, creating a seamless appearance. We assess your wall's texture during the initial site visit to recommend the best installation technique and any necessary surface preparation to achieve a clean and durable result.
acceptedAnswer.description: Chair rails can be installed on textured walls, often requiring surface preparation or careful caulking to ensure a secure, flush fit.
